name: ado
description: Azure DevOps through its own program `ado`: work items (read, history, links, attachments, saved queries; comment, update, tags, create, link, attach), pipeline runs (the stage, job and task tree, why a run failed, logs, test results, changes; queue, cancel, retry) and classic releases (deploy). Reads run; a write or a run waits for the person, or goes through for the items the task is linked to when the person opened them.
